title: CloudGoat: Lambda privesc
description: A CloudGoat scenario by Ng Song Guan (GovTech-CSG) and Rhino Security Labs, deployed into your own AWS account: starting as the IAM user Chris, assume a role with full Lambda access and iam:PassRole, then escalate to administrator through a Lambda function running as a privileged role.
question: Escalate from the IAM user Chris to full administrator access.
